changes.before: Defines a large energy use facility as a NAICS 518210 facility using or able to use 20 MW or more. Requires regulated utilities to create a separate rate class and tariff that assigns or allocates costs to those facilities and mitigates cost-shifting and grid-reliability risks.
changes.after: Enacted House Substitute 1 covers large energy use facilities under alternative 75 MW/85%-load-factor, 100 MW instantaneous-demand, or 30 MW NAICS 518210 thresholds, with aggregation and specified exclusions. Requires utility rate classifications and service/security agreements to allocate costs and protect reliability. The 180-day rate-filing deadline runs from finalization of Commission regulations, not enactment.
